title: Removed Card Refund Amount — Northgate Business Memberships
content:
**Article.** On a Northgate Memberships business membership, the removed card refund is the full add-on fee when the card is removed no more than the tier's full refund window of days after its add-on fee was charged, and nothing when it is removed later, never below zero and kept to the cent.

**Which removal and which fee.** The refund is worked out for the most recent removal of an add-on card by the primary member, from the date of that removal, the date the card was first issued, and the date and amount of the add-on fee charge for that card:

- *the removal* — the latest card deactivation on the membership whose reason is removal by the primary member, and the card it deactivated;
- *the date the card was first issued* — the issue date of that card's issuance record;
- *the add-on fee charge* — the latest add-on card fee charged on the ledger for that card, with its date and amount.

**Days after the charge.** Calendar days from the date the add-on fee was charged to the date of the removal. The tier's full refund window is a number of calendar days; a removal on the last day of the window is still inside it.

## Worked cases (hypothetical; tier with a 60-day full refund window, add-on fee 65.00)

| Fee charged | Removed | Days after the charge | Removed card refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 January 2027 | 20 January 2027 | 19 | 65.00 |
| 1 January 2027 | 2 March 2027 | 60 | 65.00 |
| 1 January 2027 | 3 March 2027 | 61 | nothing |

*Which removal (hypothetical):* a membership on which the primary member removed one add-on cardholder on 4 February and another on 9 April has the 9 April removal as its most recent removal; the refund is worked for that card and its add-on fee charge.
